name: Alex Ferreira
bio: Alex Ferreira holds a Bachelor's degree in Construction Project Management and has over 25 years' experience across construction, engineering and project delivery. He started as a draftsperson in Massachusetts, went on to run his own construction companies in the US, and later worked in quality management on large projects in Ireland and Europe.
Alex founded MF Project Solutions in 2021. He leads the larger projects and works directly with architects and commercial clients.
